scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server --if-present run typecheck:e2e
scripts.prepare: bash -c 'if [ -f lib/api-spec/scripts/install-repository-git-hooks.mjs ]; then node lib/api-spec/scripts/install-repository-git-hooks.mjs; else echo "No git-hooks installer present; skipping prepare hook."; fi'
scripts.hooks:dispatcher:install: bash -c 'if [ -f lib/api-spec/scripts/install-repository-git-hooks.mjs ]; then node lib/api-spec/scripts/install-repository-git-hooks.mjs --install-dispatcher; else echo "No git-hooks installer present; skipping dispatcher install."; fi'
scripts.hooks:dispatcher:uninstall: bash -c 'if [ -f lib/api-spec/scripts/install-repository-git-hooks.mjs ]; then node lib/api-spec/scripts/install-repository-git-hooks.mjs --uninstall-dispatcher; else echo "No git-hooks installer present; skipping dispatcher uninstall."; fi'
scripts.validate:staged-codegen-backups: bash -c 'if [ -f lib/api-spec/scripts/check-staged-codegen-backups.mjs ]; then node lib/api-spec/scripts/check-staged-codegen-backups.mjs; else echo "No staged codegen backup validator present; skipping."; fi'
scripts.validate:api-codegen: bash -c 'if [ -f artifacts/api-spec/package.json ]; then pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run check-generated; else echo "No artifacts/api-spec workspace present; skipping generated API client validation."; fi'
scripts.sync:api-break-guidance: bash -c 'if [ -f lib/api-spec/scripts/sync-contract-guidance.mjs ]; then node lib/api-spec/scripts/sync-contract-guidance.mjs; else echo "No API break guidance sync script present; skipping."; fi'
scripts.validate:api-break-guidance: bash -c 'if [ -f lib/api-spec/scripts/sync-contract-guidance.mjs ]; then node lib/api-spec/scripts/sync-contract-guidance.mjs --check; else echo "No API break guidance validation script present; skipping."; fi'
scripts.validate:api-compatibility: bash -c 'if [ -f artifacts/api-spec/package.json ] && [ -f lib/api-spec/scripts/check-contract-compatibility.mjs ]; then node lib/api-spec/scripts/check-contract-compatibility.mjs; else echo "No API compatibility checker present; skipping."; fi'
scripts.validate:native-large-text-evidence: bash -c 'if [ -f scripts/check-native-large-text-evidence.sh ]; then bash scripts/check-native-large-text-evidence.sh; else echo "No native large text evidence script present; skipping."; fi'
scripts.test:native-large-text-evidence: bash -c 'if [ -f scripts/tests/check-native-large-text-evidence.test.sh ]; then bash scripts/tests/check-native-large-text-evidence.test.sh; else echo "No native large text evidence test present; skipping."; fi'
